Overview

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive Ability: Piercing Fangs

After upgrade 4, Waterfist gains a significant boost in DPS. This enhancement results from his three hits, each now dealing 50% of his base damage, contributing to an overall 50% DPS increase.

Selling

Unit sells for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
